prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision involving a side impact at an intersection. Initial evaluation revealed tenderness, swelling, and reduced range of motion of the left wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a distal radius fracture with mild dorsal angulation, and the fracture was managed with closed reduction and a short arm cast under local anesthesia. Neurovascular status was documented as intact throughout the initial assessment.

Over the course of 11 outpatient visits, the patient was followed with serial radiographs to confirm maintenance of alignment and early fracture healing. Cast immobilization was continued for the expected healing period, followed by transition to a removable splint and a structured program of range-of-motion and grip-strengthening exercises supervised by physical therapy. Pain was managed with oral analgesics and ice, with gradual reduction in medication use noted over time.

At the most recent visit, the fracture showed radiographic evidence of consolidation, and the patient demonstrated improving wrist mobility and grip strength. Residual stiffness remains, and continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended. Return to full daily and occupational activities is anticipated as strength and motion continue to improve.
